meta.name: troy_horse
meta.prompt: The Trojan horse in Troy, right before the soldiers emerge.

tokens.scene: The Trojan horse stands inside Troy just before the hidden soldiers emerge.

character.label: ancient Troy before the hidden soldiers emerge

programs.brief: The monumental wooden Trojan horse stands inside Troy's agora, large enough to conceal a squad of Greek soldiers: hollow it into an enterable belly with cramped bunks, a ladder, a concealed hatch and the soldiers waiting inside, with no one yet outside. Publish a primary door anchor at the flank facing the agora so the approach road reaches it.

A varied low-profile covert siege cache leaves evidence of the Greek infiltration before the horse opens: a covered wooden chest, bronze gear, rope and fresh sandaled tracks tucked beside a wall, with no soldier visible. Keep each cache grounded and walkable around.
